identifier.description: An Iranian mobile number: Persian or Latin digits, spaces, +98/0098/98 or a leading 0. 'identifier' kept as the field name for one release so an older client sending 'phone'-shaped values here keeps working.
identifier.title: Identifier

expires_in_seconds.description: How long the code stays valid.
expires_in_seconds.title: Expires In Seconds

resend_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before POSTing /auth/request again.
resend_after_seconds.title: Resend After Seconds

test_code.description: Demo only: the code itself, for test numbers starting 0969 (no SMS is sent). Absent for real numbers and always absent in production.
test_code.title: Test Code

achievements_unlocked.description: Achievements this claim just unlocked, auto-paid in the same transaction -- no separate claim needed.
achievements_unlocked.title: Achievements Unlocked

streak.description: DAILY_CHECKIN only; null for every other kind.
streak.title: Streak

features.description: Read side only (F1): a section the frontend should hide entirely while its flag is false. No route enforces these yet.

location_cities.description: Real cities with lounges. Not passport cities (flavors).
location_cities.title: Location Cities

terms_required.description: false: signing up and scanning do not need accepted terms (test environments until the legal text exists). Always true in production.
terms_required.title: Terms Required

details.description: Structured extra data for a specific error code, for example ``{required, have}`` on TEAM/FLAVOR errors. Absent otherwise.
details.title: Details

examples: One character looks mistyped; check the code.
message.title: Message

request_id.description: Same as the X-Request-ID header; quote it in bug reports.
request_id.title: Request Id

ErrorResponse.description:
The shape of every error body; see docs/API_CONTRACT.md#errors.

``responses={...}`` on a route should reference this model so /docs and
the generated OpenAPI schema show the real envelope, not FastAPI's
default ``{"detail": "..."}``.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

venue_checkin.description: Daily venue QR check-in (V1, not built).
venue_checkin.title: Venue Checkin

commit.description: Deployed git commit (first 7 characters); null when unknown.
commit.title: Commit

reactions_ms.description: One reaction time (ms) per round, same count as issued.
reactions_ms.title: Reactions Ms

accepted.description: False means the run failed the server's plausibility check -- not an error, just no reward. Rewards pay only through GET/POST /challenges, never from this endpoint directly.
accepted.title: Accepted

reason.description: Only set when accepted is false.
reason.title: Reason

expires_at.description: Finish before this (2 minutes from issue) or the run is unusable.
expires_at.title: Expires At

round_delays_ms.description: Server-chosen delay (ms) before each round's "react now" signal; the client cannot know these in advance.
round_delays_ms.title: Round Delays Ms

RedeemCodeRequest.description: Raw user input or the code from the QR URL; the server normalizes it.
RedeemCodeRequest.title: RedeemCodeRequest

flavor_unlocked.description: Flavor (campaign slug) unlocked by this redemption, or null.
flavor_unlocked.title: Flavor Unlocked

flavor.description: A campaign slug from GET /config flavors.
flavor.title: Flavor

flavors.description: Lifetime code count per flavor, for the 'N more to unlock' UI.
flavors.title: Flavors

switch_allowed_at.description: When the next team change is allowed; null before any join.
switch_allowed_at.title: Switch Allowed At

team.description: Current flavor team (campaign slug), or null.
team.title: Team

next_cursor.description: Pass as ``cursor`` for the next page; null on the last page.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

last_scanned_flavor.description: Flavor of the most recently redeemed code, or null.
last_scanned_flavor.title: Last Scanned Flavor

team.description: Current flavor team (campaign slug, e.g. 'tokyo'), or null.
team.title: Team

UserUpdate.description: Every field is optional; only the ones sent are changed.
UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate

address.description: Street address in Persian; null when unknown.
address.title: Address

info.description: Backend for the TorshX x Oxin campaign passport. The contract is docs/API_CONTRACT.md; if this schema and that file disagree about a live endpoint, the contract wins and it is a bug here.
info.title: Lottery Passport API

get.description: Newest first, keyset-paginated. Pass the previous response's ``next_cursor`` as ``cursor``; ``next_cursor`` is null on the last page.

post.description: Clears the session cookie; always 204, even with no session.
Accepts Persian or Latin digits, spaces, +98/0098/98 or a leading 0. The response is the same shape for a new and a known number.

403.description: PHONE_NOT_ALLOWED (test servers: real SMS only to listed numbers)

post.description: The first successful verify creates the account. Sets the session cookie on success (see docs/API_CONTRACT.md#hosts-cors-and-cookies).

get.description: No sign-in needed. Includes locked avatars (so the frontend can show them as 'coming later'); only unlocked ones can be picked with ``PATCH /me avatar_id``.

get.summary: Active challenges and this player's progress

post.description: Idempotent per period: claiming twice in the same period pays once (409 CHALLENGE_ALREADY_CLAIMED on the second try).

get.description: No sign-in needed. Server time, the Tehran day and week keys and the limits clients must use instead of the phone clock, and the active lounges for the profile picker. Avatar/game catalogues are not included yet.

patch.description: Send any of ``display_name``, ``nickname``, ``accept_terms_version``, ``home_venue_id``, ``location_city`` and ``avatar_id``; only the fields sent change. ``profile_complete`` becomes true once a nickname is set and the terms are accepted (only the nickname when ``/config`` says ``terms_required: false``).

get.description: Parked for the MVP (ADR 0009): kept out of the player-facing contract but still tracked.

get.summary: Current flavor team and per-flavor unlock progress

post.description: Joins (first time) or switches to an unlocked flavor (5+ lifetime codes of it). Switching is locked for a while after each join; see ``GET /me/team`` for ``switch_allowed_at``.

get.summary: Coin balance and recent ledger entries

post.description: Always 200 for a structurally valid attempt, even when the server's plausibility check rejects it (`accepted: false`, no reward). Rewards pay only through GET/POST /challenges.
post.summary: Report a mini-game run's per-round reaction times

post.description: One open run per mini-game per player at a time; it expires 2 minutes after issue.
Redeem a printed code. Needs a complete profile (terms accepted and a nickname). Safe to retry: a repeat by the same user returns ``replayed: true`` instead of an error.

get.description: Always 200 once the process has started. Used by load balancers. `commit` tells a frontend developer whether their requested change is deployed yet.
503 if the database is unreachable. Used by deploy checks and uptime probes.
